label: copy-phase echo of k/o/m (early-mid recall), weak
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or <DEL>), concentrated on recall_idx 2-3 (inputs orig(1)/orig(2)) and to_go 2-6, and more in long sequences (L=9 holds 54% of mass). Strongly prefers the fed-back input k (8.4x lift, 33% of mass), then o and m (~4x); rarely fires on e or i. Mild preference for previous inputs y/a/e/g/q. Even so it fires on only ~2% of copy steps, and no token/position/context predicate tried reached precision above ~0.3 or F1 above ~0.27; the best (k/o/m in copy phase with to_go 2-6) gets F1 ~0.24 and ~50% of mass. Largest activations are k echoed at the second copy position (recall_idx 2).
